title: Sequence Decreasing
statement: The task asks for the longest subsequence of n non-negative integers (n up to 2·10^5) reducible to a non-empty all-zero array; an operation decrements an all-positive subarray and deletes one of its elements. Since each operation deletes one element, a survivor of value v needs v ≤ length−1, and pairing it with neighbours suffices. Extra elements never hurt, so the answer is n if min(a) < n, else 0.
